repos.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repos.summary_zh: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的安全工作流自动化平台，融合可视化拖拽与自定义代码（JavaScript/Python），支持 400+ 集成和原生 AI 能力（基于 LangChain），提供自托管或云端部署选项，采用公平源代码许可，确保数据控制与可定制性。
repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
repos.summary_zh: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.
repos.summary_zh: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，专为追求高效开发流程的务实开发者设计。它提供开箱即用的功能，支持快速构建安全、可维护的 Web 应用，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证系统和 URL 路由等核心组件，极大提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Django is a high-level Python web framework designed for developers who value rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It provides built-in features like ORM, admin interface, authentication, and URL routing, enabling secure and maintainable web application development with minimal boilerplate code.

repos.description: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repos.summary_zh: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
repos.summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
repos.summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

repos.description: 全栈工程师培训材料
repos.summary_zh: 全栈工程师培训材料，系统讲解JavaScript全栈开发技术，涵盖前端React、Node.js后端及工程化实践，适合有HTML/CSS/JS基础的学习者，通过四讲课程帮助掌握Web应用前后端开发技能。
repos.summary_en: Comprehensive full-stack JavaScript training material covering frontend React, Node.js backend development, and engineering practices. Designed for learners with basic HTML/CSS/JS knowledge, featuring four lectures for a two-day bootcamp on building complete web applications.

repos.description: 💻  vibe coding 101｜The first course for AI-native product builders.
repos.summary_zh: 《Easy-Vibe》是面向初学者的现代编程入门课程，主打“会说话就会做应用”的零门槛理念。通过清晰的学习地图与可视化交互教程，帮助新手系统掌握编程技能，避免学完就忘。支持多语言，涵盖从基础到实战的完整路径。
repos.summary_en: Easy-Vibe is a beginner-friendly modern programming course designed to teach coding from scratch with the motto 'if you can talk, you can build apps.' It features a structured learning map and step-by-step visual tutorials to ensure lasting understanding, supported in multiple languages for global accessibility.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Linear、Gmail、Slack、PostgreSQL 等），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档中心化工作流，用户仅需描述需求即可自动完成集成与任务执行。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP service, or local tool (e.g., Linear, Gmail, Slack, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs to offer multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—users simply describe what they want, and the agent handles execution.

repos.description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

repos.description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
repos.summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
repos.summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

repos.description: Django application and library for importing and exporting data with admin integration.
repos.summary_zh: django-import-export 是一个专为 Django 应用设计的强大数据导入导出库，支持 CSV、Excel、JSON 等多种格式，提供 Admin 后台集成和编程接口。核心功能包括数据预览、批量导入、CRUD 操作控制、外键与多对多关系处理、数据验证及自定义转换，适用于需要高效处理大规模数据迁移或批量操作的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-import-export is a robust Django library for importing and exporting data across multiple formats (CSV, Excel, JSON, etc.). It offers seamless Admin UI integration and programmatic access, featuring data preview, bulk import, CRUD control, foreign key/many-to-many relation handling, validation, and custom transformations—ideal for data migration and batch operations in Django applications.

repos.description: Material Design for Django
repos.summary_zh: Django Material 是一个为 Django 框架打造的 Material Design 3 组件库，提供完整的 CRUD 和管理界面。它基于 TailwindCSS 和 django-cotton，无需构建步骤即可使用预编译的 CSS/JS，支持响应式、无障碍访问及 SPA 式导航，专为 AI 辅助开发优化，实现快速、现代化的 Django 前端开发。
repos.summary_en: Django Material brings Google's Material Design 3 to Django with full-featured CRUD and admin interfaces. Built on TailwindCSS and django-cotton, it offers zero-build, responsive, accessible components powered by Unpoly.js for seamless navigation. Designed for AI-assisted development, it enables rapid, modern frontend development in Django without React, Vue, or Angular.

repos.description: Modern theme for Django admin interface
repos.summary_zh: Django Suit 是一个现代化的 Django 管理后台主题，提供简洁美观的界面设计，显著提升 Django 管理员的使用体验。支持 v1 稳定版与 v2 开发版，具备响应式布局和增强的交互功能，适用于需要优化后台管理界面的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: Django Suit is a modern theme for the Django admin interface, offering a clean and enhanced UI to improve the admin experience. It supports both stable v1 and experimental v2 versions, featuring responsive design and improved usability for Django projects requiring a professional admin panel.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: File and Image Management Application for django
repos.summary_zh: django-filer 是专为 Django 设计的文件与图片管理应用，提供直观的文件库管理、图片裁剪、批量操作等功能，深度集成 django CMS，支持拖拽上传、权限控制和多格式预览，显著提升内容管理系统的媒体资源管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Django Filer is a file and image management application for Django that simplifies handling of media assets. It offers intuitive file browsing, image manipulation, batch operations, and seamless integration with django CMS, enhancing content management workflows with drag-and-drop uploads, permission controls, and multi-format support.

repos.description: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
repos.summary_zh: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
repos.summary_en: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

repos.description: 🥘Base on element-ui, makes crud easily
repos.summary_zh: el-data-table 是基于 element-ui 封装的 CRUD 表格组件，支持自动请求、分页、树形数据、自定义搜索和操作列，集成 @femessage/el-form-renderer 渲染表单，通过配置化实现快速开发 RESTful API 管理界面。
repos.summary_en: el-data-table is a CRUD table component built on element-ui, featuring auto data fetching via axios, pagination, tree structures, custom search, and operation columns. It uses @femessage/el-form-renderer for form rendering and supports configuration-driven RESTful API management.

repos.description: DjangoUeditor
repos.summary_zh: DjangoUeditor 是一个用于在 Django 项目中集成百度 UEditor 富文本编辑器的 Python 模块，支持强大的 HTML 编辑功能（如拖拽调整表格单元格），提供灵活的上传路径配置和自定义按钮扩展，适用于内容管理系统、博客等富文本编辑场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoUeditor is a Python module that integrates Baidu UEditor, a powerful online HTML editor, into Django applications. It supports advanced editing features like drag-and-drop table cells and offers flexible image/file upload configurations, custom buttons, and admin integration, ideal for CMS and blog platforms.

repos.description: A full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers  | 基于 TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板
repos.summary_zh: FlareStarter 是一款基于 TanStack Start 与 Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板。它集成了鉴权、Stripe 计费、邮件、i18n 及运营后台等核心模块，利用 Cloudflare 全球边缘网络实现毫秒级响应与极低成本。项目强调端到端类型安全，提供开箱即用的生产级代码，支持 fork 即用，旨在帮助开发者快速部署具备商业闭环能力的现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: FlareStarter is a full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers. It integrates essential modules like authentication, Stripe billing, email, i18n, and an admin dashboard. Leveraging Cloudflare's global edge network, it delivers millisecond latency and near-zero operational costs. Featuring end-to-end type safety and production-ready code, it enables developers to quickly deploy modern web applications with complete commercial capabilities.

repos.description: Django markdown support and wysiwig
repos.summary_zh: Django-Markdown 是一个为 Django 框架提供 Markdown 富文本编辑支持的扩展应用，支持在模型字段、表单、管理后台及静态页面中集成所见即所得（WYSIWYG）编辑器，内置预览功能和可配置扩展，适用于内容管理系统（CMS）和文档类 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Django-Markdown is a Django app enabling Markdown WYSIWYG editing in models, forms, admin interfaces, and flatpages. It integrates a rich text editor with preview functionality, configurable extensions, and admin overrides, ideal for CMS and documentation-driven web applications.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

repos.description: Think of it as flatpages for small bits of reusable content you might want to insert into your templates and manage from the admin interface.
repos.summary_zh: django-chunks 是一个轻量级 Django 应用，提供类似 flatpages 的可复用内容块管理功能。通过简单的模型和模板标签，开发者可在后台管理界面创建命名内容块（如 'home_page_left'），并在模板中动态插入，支持富文本编辑，适用于需要多区域内容管理的场景。
repos.summary_en: django-chunks is a lightweight Django app that enables reusable content blocks similar to flatpages. It provides a model and template tag to manage named content chunks via the admin interface, allowing dynamic insertion into templates with rich text editing support—ideal for sites requiring multiple editable content areas.

repos.description: WordPress look and feel for Django administration panel
repos.summary_zh: Django WP Admin 为 Django 管理后台提供 WordPress 风格界面，支持响应式设计、可折叠侧边栏、Font Awesome 图标及9种配色主题，兼容 Python3 与多 Django 版本，显著提升后台操作体验。
repos.summary_en: Django WP Admin delivers a WordPress-inspired interface for Django's admin panel, featuring responsive design, collapsible menus, Font Awesome icons, 9 color themes, and Python3 compatibility across multiple Django versions for enhanced usability.

repos.description: SnackBase is a Python/FastAPI-based BaaS providing auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security, authentication, enterprise OAuth/SAML, and comprehensive admin UI.
repos.summary_zh: SnackBase 是一个基于 Python/FastAPI 的开源后端即服务（BaaS）平台，旨在作为 Supabase 的自托管替代方案。它提供自动生成的 REST API、多租户架构、行级安全（RLS）、企业级认证（OAuth/SAML）以及功能完备的 React 管理后台，支持 SQLite 与 PostgreSQL，助力开发者快速构建安全的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: SnackBase is an open-source, Python/FastAPI-based Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform designed as a self-hosted Supabase alternative. It offers auto-generated REST APIs, multi-tenancy, row-level security (RLS), enterprise authentication (OAuth/SAML), and a comprehensive React admin UI, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL for rapid enterprise application development.

repos.description: 文科生也会配的微信个人号后台，Content based wechat massive platform framework, what you need to do is only adding your articles in :)
repos.summary_zh: MyPlatform 是一个专为非技术用户设计的微信个人号内容管理平台，支持通过添加文章快速搭建微信公众号。基于 Python 开发，部署于新浪云（SAE），完全免费且配置简单，文科生也可在20分钟内完成搭建，实现内容分发与互动功能。
repos.summary_en: MyPlatform is a content-based WeChat personal account backend framework designed for non-technical users. Built with Python and hosted on SAE, it enables quick setup by adding articles, allowing anyone to create a functional WeChat content platform in under 20 minutes with zero cost.

repos.description: A full blog system based on Django
repos.summary_zh: GeekBlog是一个基于Django 1.6.5构建的全功能博客系统，集成MySQL和MongoDB双数据库，支持UEditor富文本编辑、多说评论、移动端适配及静态资源优化。通过django-admin-tools深度定制后台管理界面，具备完整的Feed和Sitemap功能，适合技术博主部署个人站点。
repos.summary_en: GeekBlog is a full-featured blog system built on Django 1.6.5, utilizing MySQL and MongoDB for data storage. It features UEditor rich text editing, Duoshuo comments, mobile responsiveness, and static asset optimization via Django Pipeline. The backend is enhanced with django-admin-tools for improved admin experience, supporting feeds and sitemaps for SEO.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.
